items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.32.0
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.32.0 发布：结构化决策端点、通用工具解析器与更广的低精度 KV 缓存支持
items.title_en: vLLM v0.32.0 ships structured decision endpoint, generic tool parsers, wider low-precision KV cache
items.summary: vLLM v0.32.0 ships structured decision endpoints, checkpoint-agnostic tool/reasoning parsers, and expanded low-precision KV cache support across NVFP4/FP8 and new hardware.

items.title: Namecheap just seized and disabled all my domains
items.title_zh: 系统管理员称 Namecheap 查封并停用其全部域名
items.title_en: Sysadmin reports Namecheap seized and disabled all his domains
items.summary: A sysadmin reports that Namecheap seized and disabled all their domains, sparking a large Hacker News discussion about the registrar's history of suspensions, weak account security, and post-acquisition cost-cutting.
